source.extraction: Exact JSON object assigned to const DATA; videos entries copied without field/value changes.
source.hash_scope: Full index.html bytes; git blob and working copy hashes may differ only in checkout line endings. Parsed DATA equality checked.

semantics.source_metadata: Repository gallery metadata copied verbatim, not independently verified by decoding source videos.
semantics.inferred_design_hypotheses: Properties and possible events inferred from metadata; task descriptions are intended actions, not observed event truth or exact timestamps.
semantics.unobserved: null means unknown/not measured, never no-event, no-occlusion, or zero.
semantics.camera: The label identifies the selected input view. Each episode still provides one static monocular input; the stereo name does not provide stereo observations or calibration.
semantics.evaluation_assignment: Planning exposure is not proof of a clean holdout or independent generalization. Historical tuning/manual inspection must be audited.
semantics.runtime_routing: Episode/object IDs index reports only. They must not select solver rules, numeric thresholds or per-episode patches.
semantics.cross_episode_pooling: disabled; reconstruct each episode from its own permitted input until applicable permission is established

coverage_proposal.relationship: Expanded cases supplement established dev-mini and first3; they do not supersede them, R1-R6, or the G0-G4 acceptance gates.
coverage_proposal.holdout_decision: Unassigned for every episode pending historical-use audit; audit by complete object group before any new holdout claim.
